description: Coords Copyer is a super lightweight client-side mod that copies your exact coordinates to your clipboard whenever you press C. It sends a quick confirmation in your local chat so you know it worked. Perfect for saving locations fast without pausing to type them out!

mods.name: Coords Copyer
mods.description: This mod simply copies your coords by pressing C, very simple but pretty usefull

releases.notes:
## 🚀 Coords Copyer v26.3.0

### 🔄 Platform Migration
* **Upgraded to Minecraft 26.3:** Migrated the mod codebase to target the latest *Wilderness Bound* release.
* **SDL3 Engine Compatibility:** Refactored the internal input systems to support Mojang's new SDL3 backend, successfully purging all deprecated GLFW dependency errors.

### 🛠️ Fixes & Refactoring
* **Resolved Build Errors:** Fixed compilation crashes regarding missing `org.lwjgl.glfw` packages.
* **Input System Modernization:** Updated key registration mechanics from `KEYSYM` to the current `KEYBOARD` constants.

### ⚙️ Quality of Life
* **Clearer Controls Menu:** Renamed the keybinding configuration button to **"Copy Coords"** so it is easily searchable and immediately recognizable in the game controls settings.
